input.summary: Convert mutual one-year no-hire into a narrow 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel involved in the services, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a no-hire covering all employees, so we have narrowed this to a mutual non-solicitation of personnel directly involved in the services, running 12 months from the end of that involvement, with the customary carve-outs for general advertising and unsolicited approaches. Our preferred position is no non-solicit binding us at all, but we are content with this balanced, mutual formulation.

ops.oldText: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of one year thereafter, both parties agree not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire any employee of the other party, or any person who was an employee of the other party during the previous six months and who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement.
ops.newText: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months after the end of an individual's involvement in the provision of services under this Agreement, neither party shall, and neither party shall permit its affiliates to, directly solicit for employment any employee of the other party who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement. Nothing in this Section 19 restricts either party from making general advertisements or other recruitment efforts not specifically targeted at the other party's personnel, or from hiring any person who responds to such advertisements or who approaches that party on an unsolicited basis.
